# String

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/string` (default export). The primitive text field every other field builds on. Renders plain text; edit is a single-line input.

## Usage
```ts
import StringField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/string';
```

Example: `@field name = contains(StringField)` — value `"Acme Industries"`
